description: This file defines the TaskRepository class, which manages database operations related to tasks, including retrieval, cloning, searching, and modification of task records in a MySQL database.

classes.name: TaskRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing task data in the database, including CRUD operations and complex queries.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves all tasks, optionally excluding template tasks and limiting the number of results.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of an existing task for a specified user.

methods.name: findByKeywords
methods.description: Searches for tasks where the summary or description matches the given keywords.

methods.name: findByProjectId
methods.description: Finds tasks associated with a specific project ID.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a search based on provided search criteria and optional pagination.

methods.name: getBaseSelectQueryBuilder
methods.description: Constructs and returns a base SQL select query builder for tasks with joins.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieves a task by its ID.

methods.name: deleteById
methods.description: Deletes a task by its ID.

methods.name: deleteByIds
methods.description: Deletes multiple tasks by their IDs.

methods.name: updateById
methods.description: Updates a task's columns by its ID.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new task record into the database.
